title: Northstar threading and tactical asks — Q4 iteration (v0.2)
body:
Purpose:
This doc is a lightweight, operational draft for weaving the company Northstar into the Q4 OKR slate and for producing a short, actionable all-hands + exec update plan. Working assumptions: we need clarity on 3 top-level objectives, explicit cross-team asks for the next 8 weeks, and a simple narrative for the CEO 6-minute update at the all-hands.

Status and constraints (notes to self):
- Drafting quickly to get alignment ahead of leadership week (week of Oct 13).
- Not all KR targets are final — these are proposed bands to seed discussion.
- Important tradeoff: push on Dedicated capacity sales motions vs. accelerating Private on-prem onboarding. We need to commit one primary bet.
- Risk: if we spread comms across >5 asks, adoption drops. Keep the all-hands slate to 3 asks.

Northstar (single line):
- Make inference predictable and economical across environments (hosted, dedicated, private) — measured as "median per-token $ cost reduction + 99th-pct latency SLO attainment" for core PLG customer cohort.

Proposed company objectives (Q4) — high level:
1) Objective A: Improve production economics and SLO reliability for hosted inference
   - KR A1: Reduce median per-token cost for top-10 PLG routes by 20% vs. Sept baseline (owner: Eng-serving-runtime).
   - KR A2: Achieve 99.9% uptime on hosted API (monthly) and P99 latency < 220ms for static prompt patterns (owner: SRE).
   - KR A3: Deploy two model-variant fallback flows (quantized and regional) across prod traffic with automated routing policies (owner: Platform-engineering).

2) Objective B: Expand enterprise-ready Dedicated and Private traction
   - KR B1: Sign 3 new Dedicated contracts (>$120k ARR each) with committed latency SLOs and capacity reservations (owner: Sales + Solutions-eng).
   - KR B2: Complete VPC private control-plane GA checklist for 2 pilot customers (security audit passed + KMS integration) (owner: Eng-private-deployments).
   - KR B3: Reduce Dedicated onboarding time from NDA->first-API by 30% (owner: Solutions-eng).

3) Objective C: Reduce unit cost and developer friction through Optimize tooling improvements
   - KR C1: Ship batching/caching suggestion engine MVP to console (owner: Product-optimize).
   - KR C2: Run 10 customer eval projects showing >=15% cost improvement from Optimize recommendations (owner: Developer-experience).
   - KR C3: Add per-route cost attribution into console (owner: Observability).

Cross-cutting tactical asks (8-week horizon) — keep to 3 prioritized asks for company comms:
- Ask 1: Engineering: prioritize the lightweight fallback routing + model-variant rollout (see JIRA-ENG-9987). Deliverable: traffic-aware rollout plan + canary hooks by Oct 31. Owner: Rafael Gomez.
- Ask 2: Sales & Solutions: close and pilot two Dedicated deals with early SRE onboarding. Deliverable: signed LOIs for 2 customers by Nov 15. Owner: Priya Rao.
- Ask 3: Product & DX: complete Optimize suggestion engine MVP and 3 internal customer trials. Deliverable: console opt-in + trial reports by Nov 21. Owner: Jesse Lin.

All-hands plan (CEO 6-minute narrative + 3 company asks):
- Opening (30s): Quick framing of why Q4 matters (drive uptime/latency and net-dollar efficiency).
- Progress snapshot (90s): Top metrics (Sept -> Oct trend): hosted median per-token cost, P99 latency, Dedicated pipeline value. Keep numbers crisp (we'll drop exact deltas once eng SLOs are confirmed).
- The ask (2m): Present the 3 tactical asks above. For each: why it matters (customer impact), who owns it, and a specific day-by-day commitment (e.g., canary plan, LOI target).
- Win theme + next steps (1m): What success looks like for Dec 1. Call to action for ICs + managers (where to sign up).
- Q&A logistics (remaining): Live Q&A at the end; we capture decisions in the leadership thread.

Suggested slide deck outline (minimal):
1) Title + one-line northstar
2) 3-line progress snapshot (metrics)
3) 3 company tactical asks (one slide each: problem, ask, owner, metric)
4) Timeline and commitments (8-week calendar)
5) How to help (links to trackers + office hours)

Communication and cadence for the 8-week run:
- Weekly leadership sync — Wed 10:30 PT. Short (30m). Status on each ask, blockers, escalation. Facilitator rotates.
- Biweekly cross-functional triage — Fri 9:00 PT. Deep dives only if an owner flags a blocker.
- Public tracker: add a simple sheet in Drive (name: northstar-threading-tracker-q4-v0.2) and link from console.
- Office hours: Eng drop-in Tuesday 2-3pm for rollout questions; Solutions office hours Thurs 11-12 for Dedicated onboarding.

Decision log (immediate):
- Decision 1 (need by Oct 10): Pick primary go-to-market bet for Q4: Dedicated-first (enterprisey, predictable revenue) vs Private-first (regulated customers). Proposal: prioritize Dedicated motions; mark Private pilot as high-touch parallel track.
- Decision 2 (need by Oct 12): Freeze canary rollout criteria for fallback flows (P50 target, P99 threshold, rollback window).

Risks and mitigations:
- Risk: SRE capacity to run canaries. Mitigation: reduce rollout blast radius; use limited customer cohorts and routing policies.
- Risk: Sales cycle slips. Mitigation: two-level close plan — LOI (non-binding) followed by weekly pilot readiness checkpoints.
- Risk: Message dilution at all-hands. Mitigation: limit to 3 asks, one-line northstar, visual metrics card.

Open questions for leadership (put into the leadership Slack thread):
- Do we commit to prioritizing Dedicated sales plays as the single top GTM bet? (Yes/No)
- Are the proposed KR bands acceptable or should we set harder targets?
- Who will be the official all-hands presenter for each ask (eng lead / product lead / sales lead)?

Immediate next steps (this week):
- By Oct 6: Leadership decision on primary GTM bet (Avery to capture).
- By Oct 9: Rafael to publish canary plan draft in Confluence (CONFLUENCE-12345).
- By Oct 10: Jesse to push an Optimize MVP checklist and add three internal customers to trials.
- By Oct 11: Comm lead to prepare single-slide CEO script and the three ask slides.

Notes to collaborators (informal):
- This is intentionally terse. Treat as a coordination skeleton — fill in numbers and links.
- If you add an ask, mark it clearly and explain why it displaces an existing ask.
- Track updates with a short changelog at the top of the Drive sheet.

Changelog:
- v0.1 (2025-10-03) initial sketch and objective KRs
- v0.2 (2025-10-09) tightened tactical asks; added decision deadlines and all-hands outline

End.
